fields.meta_title: NDA Form Builder for Mutual and One-Way NDAs | Emergent
fields.meta_description: What an NDA form needs, clause by clause, plus an app that picks mutual or one-way for each deal and tracks who signed. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build an NDA Form Generator and Signing App
fields.hero_description: Build an NDA form that matches the version to who is sharing and files every signed copy with its end date.
fields.features_subheading: A template gives you clauses. The app below decides which version goes out and keeps a record of every copy once it is signed.
fields.feature_1:
Mutual or one-way, picked at intake

Asks who is sharing before anything is drafted. When the other side shares back, it sends the mutual version; otherwise the one-way form goes out naming you as the discloser.
fields.feature_2:
Parties named as registered

Pulls each party's legal name and state of formation from the intake. The company that owns the information is the named party, not the employee who asked for the NDA.
fields.feature_3:
Signatures captured on screen

Collects the recipient's signature on a phone or tablet, then your countersignature, and saves the signed PDF beside the intake. An unsigned copy gets a reminder in two days.
fields.feature_4:
The four exclusions in every draft

Writes the four standard carve-outs into each version, such as information already public or material a third party passed on freely. Legal approves that wording once.
fields.feature_5:
One table of every signed NDA

Logs each signed agreement as a row with its counterparty and end date, in a database you own. Search a company name and the signed copy opens next to the intake answers.
fields.feature_6:
Code you can take with you

Exports the whole app to your GitHub on paid plans whenever you want it. A developer can connect it to your CRM there, or you can keep prompting Emergent for each change you need.

fields.tab_content_1:
A badge only after the visitor signs

Lumen Labs keeps prototypes on open benches, and every visitor signs a one-way NDA on the front-desk tablet before walking in. The signed copy saves to the visitor log with the time of entry. Reception can print a badge only once that row exists.
fields.tab_content_2:
Pricing that waits for both signatures

Northwind Foods is about to show Halden Packaging what it pays for boxes, and Halden will share its costs back. Both sign a mutual NDA first. The pricing folder link goes out by email after the second signature lands. Until then the deal owner sees the request waiting on Halden.
fields.tab_content_3:
Whistleblower notice included in every hire's copy

The Defend Trade Secrets Act requires a whistleblower immunity notice in any employee contract about confidential information. Without it, an employer suing that employee can't win exemplary damages or attorney fees. Initech's offer packet includes it, and the start-date checklist stays open until the new hire signs.
fields.tab_content_4:
Each agreement's end date, flagged 60 days out

Globex keeps 120 signed agreements in one table, each with the term its parties chose. When an NDA has 60 days or less left, the deal owner gets an email naming the counterparty. They renew it, or let it lapse and ask the other side to return or destroy what was shared.

fields.howto_title: How to Write an NDA Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to write an NDA form that covers what you will share and ends on a date both parties agree.
fields.howto_step_1_des: Ask who is sharing. When only your side discloses, a one-way NDA binds the recipient alone. When both companies will share, as in a joint product or acquisition talks, use the mutual version so each side's information gets the same protection.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Use the full registered name with its entity type, such as Northwind Foods LLC, a Delaware company. Name the business that owns the information instead of the person who asked for the NDA, and have someone with signing authority sign for it.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Describe the categories you will share: pricing, source code, customer lists, product roadmaps. Say whether material has to be marked confidential, and whether things said aloud in a meeting count once they are confirmed in writing.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Exclude information that is already public, that the recipient held beforehand, that it develops independently, or that a third party passes on without any duty of secrecy. Put these in the first draft instead of waiting for the other side's lawyer to ask.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Set the term and its start
fields.howto_step_5_des: Decide how long the duty lasts and whether the clock starts at signing or at each disclosure. Georgia Tech's legal office uses five years from receipt as its standard period. Whatever you choose, write the number of years into the agreement itself.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Limit use and plan the return
fields.howto_step_6_des: Tie use to a named purpose, such as evaluating a supply contract, and list who inside the recipient may see the material. At the end, require the recipient to return or destroy copies within a set number of days and confirm it in writing.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Sign it and file it with its end date
fields.howto_step_7_des: Collect both signatures before any material changes hands. Store the signed copy where the deal team can find it by company name, and record the end date beside it with a reminder set two months ahead.

plan.angle: The top 10 is blank documents (Cooley GO, Cornell, Hawaii and DHS PDFs, nondisclosureagreement.com, Legal Templates) and two explainers (Georgia Tech, Icertis). None of them says which version to send, tracks who signed what, or warns when a term runs out. This page explains the clauses an NDA form needs (parties, what counts as confidential, the standard exclusions, the term, mutual or one-way) and then builds the app around the document: the right version picked from an intake, signatures captured on screen, and every signed copy logged with its end date.

claims_to_source: An NDA names a disclosing party and a receiving party, defines the confidential information, and sets how long the obligation lasts (Georgia Tech's standard period is five years from receipt)
A one-way NDA covers one party disclosing; a mutual (bilateral) NDA covers both parties disclosing
Standard NDA exclusions: information already public, already known to the recipient, independently developed, or received from a third party without restriction

Under the Defend Trade Secrets Act, an employer must give whistleblower immunity notice in any contract with an employee (including contractors and consultants) that governs confidential information, or it cannot recover exemplary damages or attorney fees from that employee
Under the E-SIGN Act, a signature or contract may not be denied legal effect, validity, or enforceability solely because it is in electronic form
